verdict.rationale: Rippling documents natural-language AI for building reports and dashboards, including a 'Show me headcount vs plan' prompt. Employees can also use AI to get answers, compare plans and submit qualifying life events. That is real but narrow: natural-language use is shown for analytics and some benefits self-service, not for operating the product generally. Missing for 10: evidence of natural-language commands for core admin actions (running payroll, onboarding, permissions, workflows), detailed docs on what the AI can execute, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
